note.en: The source reports total sugars of 0 g per 100 g for light tuna canned in water without salt, weighed as drained solids. Use this plain water-packed version, not tuna in oil, mayonnaise or seasoned sauce. Fish is outside the FVNS ingredient groups. The Processed food tag records the app's canned-food avoidance preference; it is not a NOVA or health classification.
note.zh: 來源為未加鹽水浸淡色鮪魚罐頭的瀝乾固形物，總糖每 100 克 0 克。使用此原味水浸版本，不以油漬、拌美乃滋或調味醬的鮪魚代替。魚不屬於 FVNS 食材類別。Processed food 標籤僅用於本產品的罐頭食品避開偏好，不代表 NOVA 或健康分類。

note.en: The source reports total sugars of 0 g per 100 g for roasted whole lamb leg, separable lean only, with the source carcass cut trimmed to 1/4 inch fat. Weigh only edible cooked lean meat, excluding bone and separable fat. This is plain lamb, not a processed gyro loaf or marinated product. Lamb is outside the FVNS ingredient groups.
note.zh: 來源為整支烤羊腿僅分離瘦肉，原始切塊修脂至 1/4 英吋，總糖每 100 克 0 克。僅秤去骨、去可分離脂肪後的可食熟瘦肉。此為原味羊肉，不是加工 gyro 肉條或醃製產品。羊肉不屬於 FVNS 食材類別。

note.en: Fresh parsley (Petroselinum crispum) is explicitly listed among leaf vegetables in the official FVNS definitions. The recipe uses washed, drained, raw leaves, chopped but not blended into puree or paste. Its naturally occurring sugars are not free sugars under this intact-vegetable specification; this does not assert that source total sugars are zero.
note.zh: 新鮮巴西里（Petroselinum crispum）明列於官方 FVNS 葉菜定義。配方使用洗淨瀝乾的生葉，可切碎但不攪成果泥或糊。依此完整蔬菜規格，天然糖不算游離糖；並非宣稱來源總糖為零。

note.en: Spring onion is explicitly listed among onion-family vegetables in the official FVNS definitions. The recipe uses raw edible tops and bulb, washed, drained and sliced, with no sweetening or puree. Naturally occurring sugars in this intact vegetable are not free sugars; the source total sugars are not zero.
note.zh: 青蔥明列於官方 FVNS 蔥屬蔬菜定義。配方使用洗淨瀝乾、切片的生可食蔥綠與蔥白，不加糖也不打成泥。此完整蔬菜的天然糖不算游離糖；來源總糖並非零。

note.en: The source specifies toasted, decorticated sesame kernels without added salt. Toasting establishes the cooked ingredient state. The recipe grinds these weighed plain kernels without adding sweeteners; naturally occurring seed sugars are not free sugars, including in sesame paste, as illustrated by official worked example 8. Sesame seeds are explicitly eligible FVNS; toasted seeds are used only with other cooked qualifying ingredients.
note.zh: 來源指定烘烤、去殼且未加鹽的芝麻仁，烘烤提供熟食狀態依據。配方將這些秤好的原味芝麻仁磨碎，不加甜味劑；依官方範例 8，包含芝麻糊在內的種籽天然糖不算游離糖。芝麻明列為合格 FVNS，烘烤芝麻僅搭配其他熟重合格食材。

note.en: Although the full USDA description contains the word raw, its final preparation explicitly says cooked, boiled. Use peeled, cored apple pieces boiled without added sugar, then drained and weighed cooked. Do not mash, puree or blend the apple. Naturally occurring sugars in these intact cooked fruit pieces are not free sugars; the nonzero source total sugars are retained. Apples are listed FVNS fruit. Some FoodOn attributes still describe raw apple; this metadata inconsistency is retained, and the declared preparation uses the record description's explicit final cooked, boiled state.
note.zh: USDA 完整名稱雖含 raw 字樣，最終處理明確標示 cooked, boiled。使用去皮去核、未加糖水煮的蘋果塊，瀝乾後秤熟重，不壓泥、打成果泥或攪打。完整熟果塊的天然糖不算游離糖，仍保留來源非零總糖值；蘋果明列為 FVNS 水果。 部分 FoodOn 屬性仍描述生蘋果；此中繼資料不一致予以保留，配方處理狀態依據紀錄名稱明確的最終 cooked, boiled（熟、水煮）狀態。

note.en: Use fresh raw strawberries with leaves and other inedible parts removed, washed and drained. Whole or sliced berries contain naturally occurring sugars outside the free-sugars definition; do not puree or sweeten them. Strawberries are explicitly listed in the official FVNS definitions.
note.zh: 使用去葉及不可食部分、洗淨瀝乾的新鮮生草莓。完整或切片草莓的天然糖不屬於游離糖，不打成果泥或加糖；草莓明列於官方 FVNS 定義。

note.en: The source is cooked shiitake without salt, not dried mushrooms or raw mushrooms. Use plain cooked edible mushroom pieces, with tough inedible stems removed and cooking liquid drained. No sweetened glaze or puree is included. Intact mushroom sugars are not free sugars, and shiitake is explicitly listed among eligible fungi.
note.zh: 來源是未加鹽熟香菇，不是乾香菇或生香菇。使用去除不可食硬蒂、瀝去烹調液的原味熟可食香菇塊，不含含糖醬汁，也不打成泥。完整菇類天然糖不算游離糖，香菇明列於合格真菌類。

note.en: Use peeled raw garlic, sliced or chopped by hand and served without further cooking. Do not crush or blend it into a paste. Under this intact-vegetable specification, naturally occurring sugars are not free sugars; this is not a source-total-sugars zero. Garlic is explicitly listed among FVNS onion-family vegetables.
note.zh: 使用去皮生蒜，手工切片或切碎，之後不再烹煮，不壓成泥也不攪打成糊。依此完整蔬菜規格，天然糖不算游離糖；並非來源總糖為零。大蒜明列於 FVNS 蔥屬蔬菜。

note.en: Use a plain piece of hard Parmesan and grate it at assembly, not a flavored or starch-coated pre-grated blend. Naturally present milk sugars in unsweetened cheese are outside the free-sugars definition. No lactose-free treatment, added sugar, whey powder or vegetable preparation is specified. Dairy cheese is not an FVNS ingredient.
note.zh: 使用原味硬質帕瑪森起司塊，組裝時現刨，不以調味或裹澱粉的預刨混合物代替。未加糖起司中天然存在的乳糖不屬於游離糖，規格不含去乳糖處理、添加糖、乳清粉或蔬菜調製品。乳製起司不是 FVNS 食材。

note.en: Use plain Monterey cheese, without pepper, fruit, sweeteners or added whey powder, not a flavored or processed cheese blend. Naturally present milk sugars in this unsweetened dairy food are not free sugars. The source reports nonzero total sugars, retained separately; dairy cheese is outside FVNS.
note.zh: 使用原味蒙特瑞起司，不加辣椒、水果、甜味劑或乳清粉，不以調味或再製起司混合物代替。此未加糖乳製品中的天然乳糖不算游離糖；來源非零總糖仍另行保留，乳製起司不屬於 FVNS。

note.en: The selected whole-milk mozzarella source reports total sugars of 0 g per 100 g. Use plain whole-milk mozzarella, not the separately listed low-moisture, part-skim or pre-shredded source records. Dairy cheese is outside FVNS.
note.zh: 選用的全脂莫札瑞拉來源總糖為每 100 克 0 克。使用原味全脂莫札瑞拉，不套用另列的低水分、部分脫脂或預刨版本；乳製起司不屬於 FVNS。

note.en: This pinned SR Legacy record is specifically QUAKER Puffed Rice and reports total sugars of 0 g per 100 g. Puffed rice is a cereal grain, not FVNS. The recipe is an estimate from this archived product record; it is not verified against a current package or another cereal. The record lacks a full ingredient/allergen declaration, so other ingredient absences remain unknown rather than being certified.
note.zh: 此固定 SR Legacy 紀錄指定 QUAKER 膨化米穀片，總糖為每 100 克 0 克。膨化米屬穀物，不屬於 FVNS。配方依此歷史產品紀錄估算，未驗證現售包裝或其他穀片；紀錄缺乏完整原料及過敏原聲明，其他原料是否不存在仍保留未知，不作排除保證。

note.en: The source is mature soybeans fully cooked by boiling without salt. Use the hydrated edible whole beans, not dry seeds, immature edamame, tofu or soybean extract. Plain intact beans contain naturally occurring sugars outside the free-sugars definition; total sugars are not zero. Soya beans are explicitly listed in FVNS. This does not resolve the fraction of soybeans in processed tofu or soy drinks.
note.zh: 來源為未加鹽水煮至熟的成熟黃豆。使用吸水煮熟的可食完整豆粒，不是乾豆、未成熟毛豆、豆腐或黃豆萃取物。原味完整豆粒的天然糖不算游離糖，總糖並非零；黃豆明列於 FVNS。此分類不代表加工豆腐或豆飲中的黃豆比例已知。

note.en: Use the leek bulb and lower leaf portion, boiled without salt and drained before cooked weighing; exclude roots and tough upper leaves. Keep the edible leek sliced or in pieces, not pureed. Naturally occurring sugars in this intact cooked vegetable are not free sugars. Leek is explicitly listed among FVNS onion-family vegetables.
note.zh: 使用韭蔥莖基與下段葉，未加鹽水煮、瀝乾後秤熟重，排除根與粗硬上段葉。可食韭蔥保持切片或塊狀，不打成泥。完整熟蔬菜的天然糖不算游離糖；韭蔥明列於 FVNS 蔥屬蔬菜。

note.en: Use plain eggplant boiled without salt and drained, not fried eggplant or baba ghanoush. Remove the stalk and other inedible parts before final cooked edible weighing; keep the fruit in pieces. Intact cooked eggplant sugars are not free sugars, and aubergine/eggplant is explicitly listed in FVNS.
note.zh: 使用未加鹽水煮瀝乾的原味茄子，不是炸茄子或茄泥醬。去除蒂及不可食部分後秤最終可食熟重，保持塊狀。完整熟茄子的天然糖不算游離糖，茄子明列於 FVNS。

note.en: Use plain celery boiled without salt, drained and weighed cooked, with no sweetened glaze or blending. Its naturally occurring sugars are not free sugars under this intact-vegetable specification. Celery is explicitly listed as an FVNS stalk vegetable and carries the named Celery avoidance tag.
note.zh: 使用未加鹽水煮、瀝乾秤熟重的原味西洋芹，不加含糖醬或攪打成泥。依完整蔬菜規格，天然糖不算游離糖；西洋芹明列於 FVNS 莖菜，並帶有 Celery 避開標籤。

note.en: Use plain turnip root boiled without salt, drained and kept in pieces. This source is turnip, not potato or radish. The official FVNS definitions explicitly include turnip as a root vegetable, while their separate tuber exclusions name foods such as potato. Naturally occurring sugars in intact cooked turnip are not free sugars.
note.zh: 使用未加鹽水煮、瀝乾並保持塊狀的蕪菁根。來源為蕪菁，不是馬鈴薯或蘿蔔；官方 FVNS 根菜定義明列蕪菁，另列塊莖排除項目才包含馬鈴薯等食物。完整熟蕪菁的天然糖不算游離糖。

note.en: Use plain cauliflower boiled without salt, drained and weighed cooked, with no cheese sauce or puree. Naturally occurring sugars in intact cooked cauliflower are outside the free-sugars definition. Cauliflower is explicitly listed among eligible FVNS brassicas.
note.zh: 使用未加鹽水煮、瀝乾秤熟重的原味白花椰菜，不加起司醬或打成泥。完整熟白花椰菜的天然糖不屬於游離糖，白花椰菜明列於合格 FVNS 十字花科蔬菜。

note.en: Use shelled green peas boiled without salt and drained, not dried peas or pea pods. The cooked peas remain whole, not pureed. Their naturally occurring sugars are not free sugars; the source total sugars remain nonzero. Green/garden peas are explicitly listed among FVNS pod and seed vegetables.
note.zh: 使用未加鹽水煮瀝乾的去莢青豌豆仁，不是乾豌豆或豆莢。熟豌豆保持完整、不打成泥，天然糖不算游離糖，來源總糖仍為非零。青豌豆明列於 FVNS 莢及種籽蔬菜。

note.en: Reviewed recipe-input assumption: use only the archived dry red/cayenne pepper spice finely ground to powder, with nothing added or removed. USDA calls this record "Spices, pepper, red or cayenne" and does not itself establish grinding; its physical nutrient values are retained unchanged. FDA identifies red/cayenne pepper as dried Capsicum fruit. For the explicitly powdered input, UK NPM counts vegetable-powder sugars as free and excludes the powder from FVNS. Therefore the actual archived total sugars, 10.34 g per 100 g, are derived as free sugars; this is not a USDA measurement of free sugars or a separate powder-specific assay. Do not extend this assessment to whole pods, flakes or seasoning blends.
note.zh: 已審查的配方投入規格假設：僅使用此歷史來源的乾燥紅／卡宴辣椒香料，細磨成粉，不增減其他成分。USDA 紀錄名稱為 "Spices, pepper, red or cayenne"，本身未確認研磨形式，原始物理營養數值全部保留不變。FDA 將紅／卡宴辣椒定義為乾燥 Capsicum 果實。針對此明確粉末規格，英國 NPM 將蔬菜粉的糖計為游離糖，並不納入 FVNS。因此將來源實際每 100 克 10.34 克總糖推導為游離糖；這不是 USDA 的游離糖測量或另作粉末專用檢驗。不得自動套用至整顆乾椒、辣椒碎片或混合調味粉。

note.en: The USDA title and FoodOn description explicitly identify garlic powder, not garlic salt or a seasoning blend. Use plain powder with nothing added. UK NPM counts sugars in vegetable powders as free sugars and excludes the powder from FVNS; therefore the actual archived total sugars, 2.43 g per 100 g, are used as free sugars. This is a model derivation, not a USDA measurement of free sugars. The intact chopped-garlic assessment remains separate and unchanged.
note.zh: USDA 名稱與 FoodOn 描述明確為蒜粉，不是蒜鹽或混合調味料；僅使用未添加其他成分的原味蒜粉。英國 NPM 將蔬菜粉中的糖計為游離糖，且粉末不計入 FVNS，因此採來源實際每 100 克 2.43 克總糖作為游離糖。這是模型推導，不是 USDA 的游離糖測量；原有完整切碎蒜頭的評估獨立保留，不作更動。
